  WHY: The file differs from the merge-base, so the pre-push gate counts all 10 inherited `test_promote_main_cycle.py` failures as "Failures caused by this change" and reports Status: fail; the fixture cannot fix them because they fail on poll and wait budget logic, and it also changes the process-global `tempfile.tempdir` when /tmp is noexec. All reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high); gemini cited "Entire file".
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:10-231 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The autouse fixture always runs a probe subprocess (`subprocess.run([str(probe)], capture_output=True, timeout=30)`) and, when /tmp is noexec, changes the process-global `tempfile.tempdir` for the module's whole lifetime; teardown `shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)` silently ignores cleanup failures.
  WHY: The probe runs on every CI runner. Other modules in the same worker inherit the redirected tempdir, which can make unrelated tests misbehave. If `$HOME` is also noexec, `scratch` stays `None`, but the fixture still captures `tempfile.tempdir` and always restores it. Failed cleanup can leave `promote-cycle-tests-*` directories under `$HOME`. The fixture is also unrelated to #8360. Source severity: MAJOR.
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:201-231 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The autouse module-scoped fixture always spawns an exec probe subprocess, with a 30-second timeout, even on runners where /tmp can run executables.
  WHY: On a constrained runner the probe can stall for up to 30 seconds before tests start. The overhead comes only from the last run's diff and disappears once the file is restored to merge-base. Source severity: NIT.
